cq3_execution.selection_measure: local projection output NMSE on calibration rows only
cq3_execution.teacher_target: the exact BF16 source projection evaluated on exact-teacher internal activations
cq3_execution.candidate_input: the current frozen candidate internal activation on the same selected rows

aff3_execution.loss: complete-block selected-calibration-row squared error divided by exact-teacher selected-row squared energy
trainable: FP32 alpha anchors with exact FP16 hard forward
FP32 alpha codebook with exact FP16 hard forward
FP32 mu anchors with exact FP16 hard forward
FP32 mu codebook with exact FP16 hard forward
FP32 Givens angles with exact FP16 hard forward
aff3_execution.proposal: old parameter minus radius times factor times gradient divided by the global gradient L2 norm
aff3_execution.acceptance: accept the first finite hard-forward proposal no greater than the prior accepted complete-block calibration NMSE; otherwise restore the prior state
aff3_execution.checkpoint_selection: the final accepted state is the lowest accepted calibration NMSE because accepted scores are monotone non-increasing

restart_and_storage.active_boundary: one row shard while a block is incomplete; one authenticated terminal block after completion

gate_1_scoring_order: score all three final candidates once on the calibration cache
open the already sealed fresh-confirmation cache
score step-zero direct control and final trained candidate once on fresh confirmation
apply the frozen per-layer and mean-reduction gates without modification
unchanged: direct, calibration, confirmation, storage, quality, kernel, speed, memory, and energy thresholds
claim_boundary: Protocol clarification only. It contains a gate-0 pass, no trained payload, no confirmation result, no whole-model quality or speed result, and no breakthrough.
